title: Anthropic replaces Git for an agent-scale monorepo
friendlyTitle: Anthropic built new source control for very large amounts of AI-written code
summary: Anthropic says its daily merge volume rose from about 2,500 changes in May to more than 30,000 in September, pushing its large monorepo beyond the operating model of Git. It built and migrated to Scion, a centralised, horizontally scalable source-control system designed around always-online agents and jobs.
friendlySummary: Anthropic says its coding agents now create so many changes that Git became a bottleneck. The company built Scion, a source-control system designed for online agents and very large codebases.
whyItMatters: AI coding can move the bottleneck from writing code to reviewing, merging, testing and distributing it. Engineering teams adopting agents should measure those downstream constraints before assuming that faster code generation automatically means faster delivery.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can write code faster than teams can review and ship it. Businesses using coding agents may need to improve testing, review and delivery systems too.
